name: SED codes (EAZY, CIGALE, Bagpipes, Prospector)
description: Photo-z (EAZY) and SED fitting (CIGALE, Bagpipes, Prospector) through adapters in the style of the AI bridge (python_callable / local_command, profile files, mock executables); magnitudes from MAG_<band> columns, results as EZ_* / SC_* columns.

steps.label: SED Fit (external code)
steps.title: SED fit with an external code

params.name: sed-code
params.label: SED-fit code
params.help: Code used by "SED Fit (external code)": cigale = pcigale run (input files + pcigale.ini), bagpipes / prospector = Python library through the fit scripts in sed_adapters/native.

params.name: engine
params.label: EAZY engine
params.help: native = eazy-py in the interpreter below; external = classic EAZY file interface through the command below.

params.name: python
params.label: Python of the code
params.help: Interpreter that has eazy-py / bagpipes / prospector installed (empty = the one running OGFinder).

params.name: command
params.label: Command (external)
params.help: External EAZY executable (the param file is appended), `pcigale run`, or a fit script for bagpipes/prospector with the JSON protocol of docs/sed_codes.md. Split like a shell would, run without a shell.

params.name: eazy-data
params.label: EAZY data directory
params.help: Directory of the eazy-photoz repository (filters/, templates/). Empty = $EAZYCODE.

params.name: filters-res
params.label: FILTER.RES file
params.help: Overrides <eazy-data>/filters/FILTER.RES.latest (a FILTER.RES.info next to it is needed by the external engine).

params.name: prior
params.label: Apply magnitude prior
params.help: EAZY apply-prior switch (needs prior files for the filter).

params.name: point-estimate
params.label: Point estimate
params.help: peak = maximum of p(z); ml = mean of p(z) (z_m1) for the external engine.

params.name: z-column
params.label: Redshift column (SED fit)
params.help: Catalog column holding the redshift at which the SED is fitted (e.g. EZ_Z from the EAZY step, or Z_SPEC).

params.name: mag-columns
params.label: Magnitude columns
params.help: Comma-separated MAG_<band> columns, or COLUMN:BAND to assign a band to any magnitude column (MAG_AUTO:F160W) (bands known to sed_adapters/filters.py: HST ACS/WFC3, JWST NIRCam, SDSS_*, J/H/KS, IRAC1/2). Empty = every MAG_<band> except AUTO/ISO/APER.

params.name: min-mag-err
params.label: Calibration error floor (mag)
params.help: Added in quadrature to the catalog magnitude errors.

params.name: n-live
params.label: Live points (bagpipes / prospector)
params.help: Nested-sampling live points (more = slower and more reliable posteriors).

params.name: timeout
params.label: Time-out (s)
params.help: Per call of the external code.
